rootCauses.summary: The lineage read side displays currentLife.eaten, which is aggregated at hunt finish, without projecting the active session's eaten count. Powers and encounters already update during the hunt, producing contradictory growth feedback.
rootCauses.prediction: Projecting only a live, entered session into the current-life card shows two observed meals immediately, labels the current-hunt contribution and unbanked loot, and leaves persisted counters and extraction authority unchanged.
rootCauses.falsifier: Two live meals still display as zero; finished or closed sessions are added again; another life/visit is projected; rendering mutates profile, session, settlement or rewards.
